description: This file defines an Android Activity class 'ActivityTransition' that manages shared element transitions between activities, including setting up shared elements, handling click events to initiate transitions, and providing utility methods for view mappings and color generation.

classes.name: ActivityTransition
classes.description: An Android activity that demonstrates and manages scene transition animations with shared elements.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the background color, and sets up the shared element hero.

methods.name: setupHero
methods.description: Configures the hero ImageView for shared element transition, including setting the shared element callback.

methods.name: clicked
methods.description: Handles the click event on shared elements to start the transition to detail activity.

methods.name: getIdForKey
methods.description: Returns the resource ID associated with a given string key.

methods.name: getDrawableIdForKey
methods.description: Returns the drawable resource ID associated with a given string key.

methods.name: getIndexForKey
methods.description: Returns the index of a given string key within NAMES array.

methods.name: randomColor
methods.description: Generates and returns a random dark color for background.
